title: QuickSleep
description: Skip the night with only one sleeping player. Lightweight, simple and highly configurable.
body:
# QuickSleep

**QuickSleep** is a lightweight and easy-to-use Paper plugin that allows the night to be skipped when only **one player** is sleeping.

No complicated configuration, no unnecessary features—just a simple, efficient solution for your server.

## Features

* 🌙 Only one player is required to skip the night.
* ⛈️ Automatically clears rain and thunderstorms.
* 🌍 English and French language support.
* ⚙️ First-time setup with language selection.
* 💬 Simple and clean commands.
* 🚀 Lightweight and optimized for performance.

## Commands

* `/quicksleep`
* `/quicksleep help`
* `/quicksleep version`
* `/quicksleep reload`
* `/quicksleep language <fr|en>`

## Compatibility

* Paper **26.1.2**

## Upcoming Features

* Configurable messages
* Permissions
* Multi-world support
* AFK support
* Custom sounds
* More languages

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to leave feedback. Every suggestion helps improve QuickSleep!
